## What changes for users

<!-- The visible change, or "nothing" for a refactor. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run type-check`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass in `resource-scheduler/`
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] Added, removed or renamed a file in `src/components/ResourceScheduler` or changed `tokens.css`: ran `npm run registry:build` and committed `registry.json`
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/src/content/docs`, and the README props table if a prop changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
